description: This file implements a Python module for Deepgram text-to-speech (TTS) services, both WebSocket-based and HTTP-based. The classes include `DeepgramTTSService` for real-time streaming TTS via WebSocket, and `DeepgramHttpTTSService` for batch HTTP TTS requests. The module manages WebSocket connections, handles message processing including audio streaming and metadata, and provides interfaces for TTS generation with support for interruption, metrics, and connection management.

classes.description: A WebSocket-based real-time TTS service utilizing Deepgram's API, supporting audio streaming and interruption handling.
